s.note: Egg yolk mayo topped with salmon roe, plus prosciutto wrapped asparagus.
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes and halve. Mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo and 1 tsp Dijon, pipe back and top with salmon roe. Blanch a bunch of asparagus and wrap each spear in half a slice of prosciutto.

s.n: Yellow coat cheese and pineapple sticks
s.note: Cubes of sharp cheddar and pineapple on toothpicks, a 1930s club tray.
s.how: Cut 250g sharp cheddar into 2cm cubes and drain a 440g tin of pineapple pieces well. Thread a cube of cheese and a piece of pineapple onto each toothpick and stand them in half a grapefruit or lay them on a platter. Chill until serving.

m.note: Meatballs in San Marzano tomato, basil.
m.how: Mix 600g pork and beef mince with 2 slices bread soaked in milk, 1 egg and 40g parmesan. Roll into balls and brown. Simmer an hour in 2 tins San Marzano tomatoes with basil. Toss with 500g spaghetti and more parmesan.

w.note: Tart lemon filling, torched meringue. Sets as hard as Lips Manlis's bath.
w.how: Blind-bake a tin lined with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust. Cook the juice and zest of 3 lemons, 150g sugar, 3 tbsp cornflour and 250ml water until thick, then beat in 3 yolks and 50g butter. Fill, top with 3 whites whipped with 150g sugar and torch.

d.note: Gin, lime juice and cordial, shaken frosty. Breathless sings Sooner or Later.
d.how: Chill 4 coupes in the freezer for 15 minutes. Shake 200ml gin, 60ml fresh lime juice and 40ml lime cordial with plenty of ice for 15 seconds until the shaker frosts over. Strain into the coupes and float a thin lime wheel on each.
